cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to eye level with the gripper pointing up and performs a rhythmic side-to-side waving motion to greet an observer.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm moves upward to eye level, holds briefly to signal attention or acknowledgement, and ends at its expressive peak.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot simulates a respectful bow by lowering its arm from a neutral mid-body position to a lower, slightly extended position, holding the gesture at its deepest point.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot positions its gripper vertically and extends its arm forward toward the user, pausing at the peak of the extension to signal an invitation for interaction.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its gripper forward at chest level in a vertical orientation and performs a rhythmic up-and-down movement to simulate a handshake.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves in a wide arc to cross the chest and then pulls inward towards the torso, holding the position to simulate a self-hug or gesture of comfort.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: A graceful gesture where the robot brings its gripper to the mouth area and then sweeps it forward to simulate blowing a kiss.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm moves above the head to trace the silhouette of a large heart, starting from the top cleft, rounding the lobes, and meeting at a point.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the center of its chest in a slow, deliberate motion to signify sincerity, gratitude, or a deep personal connection.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm performs an energetic upward thrust, reaching a high celebratory position, followed by two emphatic vertical pumps to convey success.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: A high-energy celebratory gesture where the arm is pulled down sharply from a raised position to hip level, signifying victory or agreement.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot arm moves into a classic bicep flex position by raising the upper arm and bending the elbow inward toward the head, holding the pose to project strength.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot positions its gripper at eye level and performs a series of rhythmic downward tilts to simulate a human nodding 'yes' in agreement.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot signals negation by raising the gripper to a central position and performing a rapid side-to-side wrist rotation, simulating a head shake.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot arm lifts from a resting position to chest height, rotating the gripper to a horizontal, palm-up orientation to express uncertainty.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot moves its gripper to the side of its head and performs a series of rapid, small vertical movements to mimic a human scratching their head while confused.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot mimics human curiosity by positioning its gripper at eye level and performing a slow, deliberate lateral tilt, holding the final position to suggest observation.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot expresses annoyance or disbelief by quickly raising its arm and placing its palm against its face (forehead level), holding the position to emphasize the reaction.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot points its gripper toward its own chest to indicate itself, moving from a lower forward position to a deliberate hold near the torso.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot arm extends directly forward from a mid-torso position to point at a person or object, holding the posture to emphasize the target.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm toward the user with the gripper oriented horizontally (palm down) and performs a repetitive upward flicking motion using the wrist and elbow joints to beckon them closer.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position into a sharp, forward-extended 'stop' gesture with the gripper pointing up and the opening plane facing the viewer.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot raises its arm from chest level to eye level with the gripper pointing straight up, signaling a pause or an upcoming important point.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot raises its gripper to the mouth area, oriented vertically, to gesture for silence.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its hand to the stomach region with the gripper pointing inward and performs a series of light, quick patting motions to signal hunger or fullness.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm reaches across its chest toward the opposite shoulder and performs a rapid, repetitive up-and-down rubbing motion to simulate shivering and the need for warmth.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its hand to face level and performs a rapid, repetitive fanning motion with its wrist to indicate feeling hot.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot simulates the act of yawning by bringing its gripper up to its mouth level, pointing inward, and executing a slight tremor to show tiredness.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot arm lifts its hand to eye level and performs small, repeated lateral movements near the eye area to mimic the gesture of rubbing one's eye when tired.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot executes a slow, deep bow by lowering the arm forward and down while keeping the gripper pointed toward the floor, expressing deep regret or formal respect.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot positions its arm at eye level with the gripper pointing up, then executes two quick downward flicks of the wrist to simulate the 'air quotes' gesture.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot arm raises to its temple and performs a series of quick, rhythmic taps to suggest intelligence, a good idea, or deep thought.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: A gesture where the robot indicates that something is 'crazy' by pointing its gripper at its temple and rotating it in circles.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: A 'zip your lips' gesture where the robot positions its hand at the side of the mouth and sweeps it horizontally across to signify keeping a secret.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot moves its arm across its torso at chest height, creating a folded, defensive posture that signals closure or protection.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot simulates a 'hands on hips' stance by moving its arm to a lateral hip position with a flared elbow. The quick movement and firm hold convey a sense of confidence, readiness, or impatience.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot demonstrates curiosity or engagement by extending its arm forward and slightly upward, orienting the gripper horizontally to simulate an open-palm gesture.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot mimics a startled human reaction by quickly retracting its arm towards its chest and upward, while orienting the gripper vertically to represent defensive palms.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot quickly raises its hand to its mouth area with the gripper pointing toward the face to simulate a gasp or 'oops' reaction.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot mimics a respectful bow by bringing its gripper to the center chest in a vertical 'prayer' orientation and then tilting its arm forward and down to hold a position of gratitude.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot mimics a toast by lifting its arm from chest level to eye level while maintaining a vertical grip as if holding a glass.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot raises its arm from a neutral lower position to chest height with the gripper pointing up and the palm facing forward, inviting a high-five interaction.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot simulates a high-five by lifting its arm to a high position with the gripper pointing up, then swinging it downward and forward with force.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot arm moves from a mid-low position into an extended forward reach at chest height with the gripper oriented vertically, mimicking a human offering a fist bump.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot extends its arm forward at chest height with the gripper oriented vertically to represent a fist, then executes two sharp, rhythmic tapping motions.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: A self-congratulatory gesture where the robot reaches over its shoulder and taps its upper back area multiple times in a rhythmic fashion.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot arm extends forward and performs a continuous double-circular motion in a vertical plane to indicate repetition, continuation, or moving around something.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its neck and performs a sharp, high-speed horizontal slice across its throat to signal an immediate stop or termination.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: A dismissive gesture where the hand starts tucked under the chin and then flicks rapidly outward, signaling indifference or rejection.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot extends its arm forward at waist height and performs a rapid, rhythmic up-and-down tapping motion with the wrist to simulate drumming fingers in impatience or boredom.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its hand forward with the gripper oriented horizontally (palm up) and performs a repetitive beckoning motion with the wrist to request an object.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot moves its arm from a low resting position near the waist to an extended forward position with the gripper oriented horizontally (palm up), performing a steady and inviting offering gesture.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot transitions from a neutral stance to a high, wide-reaching posture with the gripper pointing upwards, signaling a gesture of surrender or 'I give up'.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot reacts to a loud sound by quickly bringing its gripper to the side of its head in a protective gesture, holding it there to signal discomfort.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot arm moves from a central neutral position to a wide outward extension to simulate a welcoming or inclusive gesture.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot arm extends fully upward to a high position, performing a slow, deliberate reaching motion followed by small pulses to simulate a satisfying physical stretch.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: A crisp military-style salute where the arm is raised quickly to the temple and held briefly.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot arm lifts its gripper to the forehead level, oriented horizontally to mimic a sun visor. It then executes a slow, deliberate side-to-side rotation to simulate scanning the horizon for something in the distance.
